From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 22, 2019 2:33 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Line 
 
Making the lead this:

The Houston Astros blocked the Detroit Free Press from attending Justin Verlander’s postgame media scrum on Wednesday night, violating Baseball Writers’ Association of America protocol and possibly the MLB collective bargaining agreement.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Thursday, August 22, 2019 2:10 AM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Line

The incident came hours after Dias told the Free Press reporter that the team would prefer the reporter did not attend Verlander’s postgame media session, and one day after Verlander refused to speak with credentialed media with the reporter around.
